notes.title: TEOM Big Update
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that our game has undergone many changes! We have listened carefully to our community and worked hard to create a product that meets all your needs.

We are also thrilled to present a new trailer that gives you a taste of the updates and improvements we’ve made.

We are proud to announce that we will be participating in Steam's Tower Defence Fest. This is a great opportunity for us to showcase our game and connect with even more players.

Try the new demo and let us know what you think. Your feedback is crucial and will help us further improve the game. 

Thank you for your continued support and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 0.6.67
notes.content:
NEW:
-All the level, Units end Enemies have been balanced.
-Added Units and Enemies Glossary.
-Added a system that evidences the grid for units that can be placed on the ground. -Level D5 reworked with new gameplay mechanics.
-Added BONUS and MALUS on some units and enemies.
-Added the damage type icon on the Units.
-Added the inspector.
-Added a UI alert that warns the bases that will sink.
-Added stars and score at the end of the level.
-Added placing Unit animation and sound.
-Added life bar and model animation when an enemy is hit.
-Added life bar size setting.
-Added Hackerbot effects.
-Added the Foamgun into level B2.
-Added drag-and-drop effects and sounds.
-Now the units have different repair times.
-Improved the money UI for better readability.
-Hustle enemy reworked.
-Minicore’s model improved.
FIXES:
-Fixed Wormhole ability.
-Fixed a bug that didn't allow enemies to exit the door.
-Fixed an issue that some enemies could get stuck in front of the Landmine. -Fixed an issue that hides the tutorial’s indicator.
-Fixed an issue that units could damage the core.
-Fixed an issue that some abilities and units couldn’t trigger the explosive barrels. -Fixed the Skill menu behavior.
-Fixed Enemies' shields.
-Fixed the setting saves.
-Fixed enemies getting stuck.
-Fixed an issue that left two shields around the core during the victory.
-Fixed the money system.
-Fixed an issue that left flames on units after the repair.
Other minor bugs were fixed and general improvements were made.
